description: Fix Duo MFA lockouts in one command and see every MSP subaccount at once, with signed Admin API calls.

auth_env_var_specs.name: CISCO_DUO_IKEY
auth_env_var_specs.description: Admin API integration key (ikey), e.g. DIWJ8X6AEYOR5OMC6TQ1.

auth_env_var_specs.name: CISCO_DUO_SKEY
auth_env_var_specs.description: Admin API secret key (skey). Used only to sign requests.

auth_title: Duo Admin API integration key + secret key

novel_features.name: Lockout triage
novel_features.description: See why one user cannot complete Duo MFA: status, lockout reason, the group status that overrides it, phones, outstanding bypass codes, last 24h failures, and the exact next command to run.

novel_features.name: Lockout fix
novel_features.description: Unlock a locked-out user, and with --bypass issue a single-use one-hour bypass code or with --reactivate-phone re-send Duo Mobile activation; a preview by default, --apply makes the changes and prints a before/after receipt.

novel_features.name: Phone swap
novel_features.description: Move a user to a new phone number: reuse or create the phone, attach it and text the activation link; a preview by default, --apply makes the changes. Old phones are retired on a second run once the new phone is activated, and a phone shared with another user is never deleted.

novel_features.name: Fleet summary
novel_features.description: One row per customer subaccount: edition, users against user limit, telephony credits, admin and integration counts. Needs an Admin API app in the MSP parent account; covers every subaccount and ignores --account-id.

novel_features.name: Fleet risk
novel_features.description: Per-customer counts of users in bypass, locked out, disabled, pending deletion or unenrolled, members of Bypass or Disabled groups, and standing bypass codes. Needs an MSP parent Admin API app; ignores --account-id.

novel_features.name: Fleet find-user
novel_features.description: Find which customer tenants (and the MSP parent) contain a username, alias or email, with status and last login for each hit. Needs an MSP parent Admin API app; ignores --account-id.

novel_features.name: Bypass exposure
novel_features.description: List every synced user who can skip MFA: bypass status, a Bypass group, or a bypass code that never expires or has unlimited reuse, with the admin who issued it. Needs 'sync --resources users,bypass_codes' first; JSON reports complete=false when data is missing.

novel_features.name: Stale audit
novel_features.description: Find unenrolled users heading for a lockout, inactive and pending-deletion users, expired, inactive or never-logged-in admins, and phones not seen recently. Needs 'sync --resources users,admins,phones' first; JSON reports complete=false when data is missing.

novel_features.name: Enrollment chase
novel_features.description: List users still unenrolled after a given age (by default) and, with --apply, re-send their Duo enrollment emails, oldest first, up to --limit.

novel_features.name: Failure rollup
novel_features.description: Roll up failed and fraud authentications per user, reason, factor and application over a window, with first and last seen and source IPs.
